title: Extension of the Gyarfas-Sumner conjecture to digraphs (Aboulker, Charbit, Naserasr, 2020)

central_question: Problem 1.2 of arXiv:2009.13319: characterize the finite sets F of digraphs that are HEROIC, i.e. for which the class Forb_ind(F) of digraphs avoiding every member of F as an INDUCED subdigraph has BOUNDED dichromatic number chi_d. This generalizes the Gyarfas-Sumner conjecture (graphs/chromatic) and the Berger-Choromanski-Chudnovsky-Fox-Loebl-Scott-Seymour-Thomasse notion of a hero tournament to digraphs. The conjectured answer (the paper's main conjecture, Conjecture 4.2) is a structural characterization in terms of the substitution-closure of {transitive tournaments, directed-cycle blowups} plus the digon obstruction; the bounded-vs-unbounded dichotomy is the load-bearing open content.

benchmark.description: F is heroic iff Forb_ind(F) has bounded chi_d. 'Bounded' is ASYMPTOTIC: finite enumeration can DISPROVE a claimed heroic set (exhibit a member of Forb_ind(F) with large chi_d) or settle a finite-target subclaim EXACTLY, but cannot PROVE boundedness. chi_d(D) = min #colors so each class induces an acyclic subdigraph, computed EXACTLY via SAT + lazy directed-cycle clauses. NOTE (round 3): when a non-oriented graph H (e.g. K3, K4) is in F, Forb_ind(F) forbids EVERY ORIENTATION of H as an induced subdigraph; PDF line 315-316. Forbidding K3 == triangle-free (forbids both TT3 and C3); the oracle's named 'C3' is the directed 3-cycle ONLY and is STRICTLY WEAKER than forbidding K3.

ground_truth_landmarks.thm_6_5: chi_d(Forb_ind(K2, K3, P+(3))) = 2, where K3 forbids ALL triangle orientations (= triangle-free). Oracle-verified finite landmark over the genuine triangle-free P+3-free class up to n=8 (round 3): 0 members with chi_d>=3 (n=8 full sweep = 151439 members), max chi_d=2 throughout. The paper's proof (PDF lines 662-680) is the source of the all-n statement; it uses K3-freeness twice ('Since D is K3-free, L1 is a stable set'; 'a1 and b are non-adjacent because D is triangle-free').
ground_truth_landmarks.thm_2_1: chi_d(C_k(D_1,...,D_k)) for k>=3 satisfies chi_d(C_k(D,...,D)) = chi_d(D)+1. RAN: cyclesub k in {3,4}, base in {K1,K2sym,C3} all match (e.g. C3(C3,C3,C3) -> chi_d 3 = 2+1).
ground_truth_landmarks.tournament_tower: D_1=K1, D_k=C3(D_{k-1},D_{k-1},K1) gives chi_d(D_k)=k. RAN tower 1..6: D_2=C3 (n=3,chi=2), ..., D_6 (n=63,chi=6); each is a TOURNAMENT (digon-free). Explicit unbounded-dichromatic family. KEY STRUCTURAL FACT: being a tournament, D_k has NO non-adjacent pair, hence NO induced P+(m) for ANY m>=2 -> it lies in Forb_ind(K2,P+(m)) for every m. NOTE: the tower is triangle-RICH (it contains TT3/C3), so it is NOT in any K3-forbidding class -- it only disproves heroicness of the digon+path sets WITHOUT the triangle member (H2).
ground_truth_landmarks.k4free_bounds_from_paper: VERIFIED vs Refs/heroic_2009.13319.pdf: (i) abstract 414 bound is Theorem 6.9, line 858: chi_d(Forb_ind(K4, P+(3))) <= 414 -- forbids K4 (all orientations) and P+(3), but does NOT forbid the digon K2. (ii) With the digon forbidden the in-paper bound is much smaller: line 626 chi_d(Forb_ind(K2, K4, P+(3))) <= 8, and Lemma 6.6 (line 695) chi_d(Forb_ind(K2, K4, P+(3), C3)) <= 8, Lemma 6.7 (line 784) chi_d(Forb_ind(K4, P+(3), R)) <= 66. The H3 sweep forbade digons (K2sym) + K4 + P+3, so its relevant published bound is <=8, NOT 414. Observed max_chi_d=2 is well inside both. All are PROVED-bounded classes -> red-teaming them is audit, not frontier.
ground_truth_landmarks.abstract_multipartite: An orientation of a complete multipartite graph with no directed triangle is 2-colorable (abstract). Finite-checkable on small instances.
ground_truth_landmarks.digon_dichromatic: chi_d(K2sym)=2 (a digon is a directed 2-cycle, endpoints need distinct colors); chi_d generalizes the chromatic number.
ground_truth_landmarks.necessity_already_proved_in_paper: VERIFIED vs Refs/heroic_2009.13319.pdf Section 6.1: the NECESSITY ('only if') half of Conjecture 4.2 is ALREADY PROVED via the C4-substitution tower D_1=K1, D_{i+1}=C4(D_i,...,D_i): D_i in Forb_ind(K2,K3,P4) with chi_d(D_i)=i. CAUTION (round 3): this C4 tower IS triangle-free at i<=2 but NOT at i>=3 (D_3 contains an induced TT3 = orientation of K3), so the published necessity construction does NOT live in the K3-forbidding class for i>=3 -- the paper's necessity statement is about Forb_ind(K2,K3,P4) membership for the relevant levels per its own argument; the engine must not re-derive a 'disproof' by ignoring K3-membership (see G4). The OPEN content is the SUFFICIENCY/boundedness ('if') direction.

proved.claim: Theorem 6.5 finite landmark: chi_d(Forb_ind(K2, K3, P+3)) = 2 (K3 = triangle-free) holds EXACTLY over the genuine triangle-free P+3-free class up to n=8 (round 3: n=8 full sweep = 151439 members, ZERO with chi_d>=3, max chi_d=2; extends the prior n<=6 landmark).
proved.status: oracle-verified finite landmark (NOT the asymptotic theorem; the paper's proof is the source of the all-n statement). This is the anti-hallucination anchor.

proved.claim: Thm 2.1 substitution identity chi_d(C_k(D,...,D)) = chi_d(D)+1 holds for the tested (k in {3,4}, D in {K1,K2sym,C3}); consequently the tournament tower D_k has chi_d(D_k)=k (verified k<=6), so finite sets need NOT be heroic.

open_crux: ONLY the SUFFICIENCY ('if') half of the heroic dichotomy (Conjecture 4.2) is open; the NECESSITY ('only if') half is ALREADY PROVED in the paper (Section 6.1 C4-substitution tower) and that route is CLOSED as already-known. ROUND-3 FRONTIER CLARIFICATION (load-bearing): the candidate-heroic triangle member is K3 (the UNDIRECTED triangle = ALL orientations TT3+C3 = TRIANGLE-FREE), NOT the directed C3 the prior ledger wrote; so H1's class is Forb_ind(K2,K3,P+(k)) = triangle-free P+(k)-free oriented digraphs, which the oracle's triangle-free measure-sweep already realizes correctly. The DISPROOF side is mature and CLOSED for the digon+path sets: the tournament tower shows Forb_ind(K2,P+(m)) is non-heroic for every m>=2 (tower is a tournament, avoids all induced P+(m); chi_d=k unbounded) -- confirming the triangle member is load-bearing. What remains is BOUNDEDNESS of a candidate heroic F that forbids K3 (triangle-free): a SYMBOLIC proof that some specific F (e.g. {K2,K3,P+(k)}, H1) has bounded chi_d, supported by the oracle on small n (now n<=8). ROUTES NOW CLOSED computationally: (a) triangle-free chi_d>=3 seed in n<=20 (G1); (b) the C4-tower disproof (G4, relabeling error -- D_3 has induced K3); (c) the bounded-FVS structural lever for boundedness (G5 -- FVS grows 2->3 at n=8, decoupled from chi_d); (d) the P+(4)-vs-high-girth literature reduction (G6 -- high girth FORCES induced P+(4), inverting the intuition). The K4-free superset sweep (H3) only RE-confirms a class the paper already proved bounded (<=8 / <=414), so it is audit, not a new lever. The engine's remaining computational leverage is thin: either (i) verify the Harutyunyan-Mohar large-n triangle-free chi_d>=3 citation (H4) to settle whether a triangle-free unbounded family even exists beyond the enumerable range, or (ii) find a NEW structural invariant that DOES transfer small-n boundedness to a chi_d bound (FVS failed). A symbolic 'nice-set' argument in the paper's own style is the likely real path -- that is human math, not enumeration.

This is a SUFFICIENCY (boundedness) claim -- the open direction. NOTE (round 3 correction): the forbidden triangle member is K3, not the directed C3 written in earlier rounds.
live_hypotheses.status: OPEN, untested for k>3. Boundedness evidence for k=3 now extends to n=8 (genuine triangle-free class, 0 chi_d>=3). The bounded-FVS reduction route to a symbolic proof is dead (G5).
live_hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: For each fixed k, sweeping oriented triangle-free P+(k)-free digraphs over small n, max chi_d stays bounded and does NOT grow with n. So the 'max chi_d=2 over all triangle-free oriented digraphs' statement is only a finite (n<=~11) landmark, NOT a theorem.

discipline_gates.empirical_not_proof: 'Heroic'/'bounded chi_d' is an ASYMPTOTIC quantifier. A claimed heroic set staying bounded over enumerated small n is SUPPORTING evidence only -- it CANNOT enter 'proved' without a symbolic boundedness argument. Conversely a single Forb_ind(F) member with chi_d above the claimed bound IS a sound disproof; a CONSTRUCTIBLE family with chi_d->infinity inside Forb_ind(F) is a sound disproof of heroicness (H2), but its all-k unboundedness still needs a symbolic identity proof to be fully rigorous and so stays out of 'proved'. Finite landmarks (Thm 6.5 chi_d=2 up to n=8, Thm 2.1, tower to k=6) are exact verifications of finite-target subclaims, not proofs of the all-n theorems.
discipline_gates.audit_not_redteam: Grounding (oracle measures chi_d / containment) and skeptic (search for an unbounded-chi_d witness inside Forb_ind(F), OR check that a claimed contribution is novel vs the primary source -- G3 and G4 were killed precisely because the skeptic cross-read the paper and found a published construction / a relabeling error) are separate agent calls, never merged. RE-CONFIRMING A CLASS THE PAPER ALREADY PROVES BOUNDED (H3 K4-free, <=8/<=414) is audit, not red-team, and carries near-zero evidential weight.
discipline_gates.citations_verified: Any external citation (Berger et al. hero characterization Thm 2.2; the five minimal non-heroes; Harutyunyan-Mohar [11] large-n triangle-free chi_d>=3 of H4) must resolve to a primary source before it carries weight. Berger Thm 2.2 and the primary Harutyunyan-Mohar [11] are currently UNVERIFIED and must not be load-bearing until checked (the paper's internal attribution to [11] at line 214/900 is consistent but is not the primary source).
